text:
mika: Kicking off a short follow-up thread for the authz postmortem. Recurring pattern: some services missing audit annotations + stale long-lived tokens. Goal: capture owners, short deadlines, and a simple metric to detect recurrence.

priyanka: I'll take the immediate token sweep + a safe rotator script. Plan: dry-run tonight, staging deploy tomorrow. Owner: @priyanka. Target: dry-run complete by T+1 (24h).

navid: I'll add an admission policy that rejects manifests without `audit/logs: enabled` for prod namespaces. Owner: @navid. Target: PR by T+3. Will include an exception list for infra-owned legacy services.

olivia: I'll draft the emergency fallback runbook (manual rotate steps, who to page, rollback hints). Owner: @olivia. ETA: T+2 morning.

sam: I'll create a minimal dashboard: percent services with audit annotation + weekly rotated token count. Also add an alert if rotated tokens spike unexpectedly. Owner: @sam. ETA: T+4.

priyanka: Quick helper to enumerate service tokens I used: `kubectl get secrets -A -l redwood/service-token -o jsonpath='{range .items[*]}{.metadata.namespace}/{.metadata.name}{"\n"}{end}'`  (will attach CSV snapshot).

sec-bot: security: Created SEC-1201 "Audit annotation enforcement & token sweep" and linked incident-712. Priority: P2.

ops-bot: deploy: Canary scheduled: admission-policy canary to dev at 2024-07-25T02:00Z.

mika: Action checklist (condensed):
  - priyanka: rotator dry-run -> staging deploy (T+1)
  - navid: admission policy PR + exception list (T+3)
  - olivia: manual rotation runbook + page list (T+2)
  - sam: dashboard + alert (T+4)

mika: Proposed quick metric to track recurrence: audit_hook_coverage (%) and token_age_95th_percentile. We'll require >95% coverage for 2 consecutive weeks before closing.

priyanka: PR opened for rotator (dry-run mode): https://git.internal/redwood/ops/rotator/pull/21. Please review. Includes `--dry-run`, `--max-parallel=3`, and `--introspect-timeout=5s`.

navid: Draft PR for admission policy posted: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/pull/314. Note: added allowlist annotation for infra-managed services.

olivia: Runbook draft: https://docs.redwood/runbooks/emergency-token-rotate.md. Includes manual revoke/recreate steps and escalation matrix.

sam: Dashboard: https://dash.redwood/internal/authz/coverage. Will add weekly summary emails to ops mailing list.

mika: Quick sync scheduled tomorrow 09:30 PT to confirm blockers. If anyone is blocked, drop short status here before 09:00 PT.

priyanka: Rolling dry-run now. Posting results in 30m.

navid: Noted. One ask: can rotator respect active sessions? If not, we'll need to add `dry-run` verification that the service can accept new tokens.

priyanka: Adding integration check to introspect before revoke; will skip rotate if active sessions > 0 and flag for manual review.

mika: Great. Thanks all. We'll keep this thread as the authoritative follow-up until checklist is green. :thumbsup:
